factText: IRDAI capped pre-existing disease waiting periods at 36 months as of 2024, protecting consumers from excessively long waits.
Health insurers in India disallowed claims worth ₹15,100 crore in FY 2023-24 — about 12.9% of total claims by value.
Standalone health insurers' average incurred claim ratio was 63.63% in FY 2023-24, vs 97.23% for PSU general insurers.
Public sector insurers settle ~98% of health claims by count, but ICR over 95% can also signal financial stress.
Around 73,729 health insurance complaints were filed in FY 2024-25, a 14.5% rise — claim rejections were the leading reason.
After 8 years of continuous coverage, all pre-existing diseases are automatically covered under the moratorium period provision.
The non-life insurance sector moved from a net loss of ₹2,566 crore in FY 2022-23 to a net profit of ₹10,119 crore in FY 2023-24.
IRDAI requires claim decisions within 30 days of receipt of all documents, with penal interest if delayed.
High claim settlement ratio may hide low-ticket easy claims being paid while high-value claims face friction — always check ICR and complaint data too.
Network hospital counts are self-reported by insurers and not audited by IRDAI — verify actual availability in your city.
A single serious hospitalization in a metro private hospital can easily exceed ₹3-5 lakh, with complex surgeries going into ₹10 lakh+.
Room rent sub-limits can significantly reduce effective coverage — a ₹10L policy with ₹5K/day room cap may leave you paying heavily out-of-pocket.
The Insurance Ombudsman resolved about 87% of entertainable complaints within 90 days in FY 2023-24.
Of 52,575 total insurance complaints received by Ombudsmen in FY 2023-24, health insurance accounted for 31,490 — the highest category.
IRDAI mandates a minimum solvency ratio of 1.50 for all insurers — ratios below this trigger supervisory intervention.
About 69% of insurance sector grievances in FY 2024-25 were claim-related, underscoring that claim service is the main pain point.
Extremely low ICR (<60%) for multiple years may indicate aggressive pricing or high claim repudiation — not always consumer-friendly.
You have a 15-30 day free look period to review your policy and cancel for a full refund if not satisfied.
Portability allows you to switch insurers without losing waiting period credits and no-claim bonus — apply at least 45 days before policy expiry.
IRDAI data is typically released 6-9 months after fiscal year end — current insurer performance scores reflect recent history, not today's exact operations.
All claim and complaint statistics are at insurer level, not per plan — two products from the same insurer share the same claim profile.
Bima Bharosa (bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in) is IRDAI's free online portal to register and track insurance complaints — use it before approaching the Ombudsman.
